english.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese word for a grassy area kept short around a house.
Use 草地 specifically for a lawn or an area covered with grass, rather than just individual grass plants.

examples.english: The lawn in front of the house needs to be kept short.
examples.traditional: 屋企前面塊草地要成日剪短啲。
examples.jyutping: uk1 kei2 cin4 min6 faai3 cou2 dei6 jiu3 seng4 jat6 zin2 dyun2 di1

examples.english: The kids are playing soccer on the grass.
